key_insight: Extra observations can make worst-case NP-hard noisy parity fitting exactly tractable without changing its objective or feasible set.
engineering_relevance: For systems matching the paper’s sampling and noise assumptions, collecting more readings can enable exact optimization with near-linear computational work.
method: Analyze uniformly sampled rank-one sign tensor entries with independent fair factor signs and independent errors.
For fixed interaction order k ≥ 3 and logarithmic mean degree, add O(n/(log n)^(1/(k−2))) readings of the same source.
Use a common signed-field law to characterize gains, tied optima and reweighting dimension, and residual geometry to characterize local verification.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical high-probability guarantees of exact optimization in O(n log² n) worst-case work and a sharp leading coefficient for weak recovery within a specified class of local estimators.
watch_item: The guarantees require known channel biases and specific sampling and independence assumptions; robustness to real-world deviations is not established in the abstract.
paper_title: From NP-Hardness to Exact Tractability Through Sample Abundance
